Chances were limited, and the game remained locked in a physical battle. Robert Renan was the only player to be cautioned before the referee signaled the halftime break, sending the teams back to the dressing rooms with the scoreline unchanged. Second-half resurgence The intensity shifted dramatically after the break as both managers introduced fresh legs to try and break the deadlock. The breakthrough finally arrived in the 68th minute, when Gabriel Barbosa capitalized on an assist from Benjamin Rollheiser to put his side ahead. The goal sparked the match into life, leading to a thrilling final twenty minutes. Willian Arao leveled the score in the 77th minute, and the momentum swung entirely in favor of the visitors when Luan Peres found the net just four minutes later. Despite a late yellow card for Paulo Henrique , the defense held firm, and the match concluded at 90+5 minutes.
